# Framework mappings

One file per framework. Each lists the controls we map, what they cover, and which checklist items they support. Paraphrases are ours; read the source before relying on one.

| Framework | Type | File |
|---|---|---|
| FINOS AI Governance Framework | Industry framework | [finos.md](finos.md) |
| FS-ISAC Generative AI Vendor Risk Assessment Guide | Industry framework | [fsisac.md](fsisac.md) |
| NAIC Model Bulletin on the Use of Artificial Intelligence Systems by Insurers | Supervisory guidance | [naic.md](naic.md) |
| NYDFS Cybersecurity Regulation, 23 NYCRR Part 500 | Binding law or regulation | [nydfs500.md](nydfs500.md) |
| NYDFS Industry Letter, Cybersecurity Risks Arising from Artificial Intelligence | Supervisory guidance | [nydfs_ai.md](nydfs_ai.md) |
| NYDFS Insurance Circular Letter No. 7 (AIS and ECDIS in underwriting and pricing) | Supervisory guidance | [nydfs_cl7.md](nydfs_cl7.md) |
| CSA AI Controls Matrix (AICM) and AI-CAIQ | Industry framework | [aicm.md](aicm.md) |
| ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI management system, Annex A | Certifiable standard | [iso42001.md](iso42001.md) |
| NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1) | Voluntary government framework | [nist_rmf.md](nist_rmf.md) |
| NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile | Voluntary government framework | [nist_600_1.md](nist_600_1.md) |
| EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 | Binding law or regulation | [eu_ai_act.md](eu_ai_act.md) |
| Digital Operational Resilience Act, Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, and its RTS | Binding law or regulation | [dora.md](dora.md) |
| Shared Assessments Standardized Information Gathering (SIG) questionnaire | Industry framework | [sig.md](sig.md) |
